result.description: Communications API platform for SMS, voice, messaging channels (WhatsApp etc.), verification, video, numbers and network APIs.
result.auth_detail: API key + secret via HTTP Basic (or SIP Digest); JWT signed with Application private key (recommended, needed for webhooks/ACLs); Video uses bearer token built from JWT. No OAuth2 authorization-code flow for third-party users — creds are per Vonage account/application.
result.access_detail: Sign up on dashboard, get API key/secret and create Applications for private keys. Free credit on new account, then pay-per-request. Some channels (WhatsApp, sender IDs, some numbers/regions) need extra registration/approval, but core API access is self-serve. Pricing page returned 403 so trial limits not checked.
result.api_notes: Many REST APIs: SMS, Messages, Voice, Verify, Number Insight, Numbers, Accounts, Application, Conversation, Reports, Redact, Video, SIP, Identity Insights, network APIs. Webhooks for inbound events. Official SDKs in multiple languages.
